overview: Gunasekaran drives his own car. Anbu and Kanimozhi fall in love. In order to prevent the Chief Ministers video from getting out, Chief Minister Assistant and Inspector Muthu Karupan kills a young man. They put the blame on Gunasekar. This story is about how Anbu saves Gunasekaran from this.

title: Sundarapandian
overview: Sundarapandiyan , who has finished college and goofs around in his village with friend Murugesan , decides to pitch in when Arivazhagan seeks his help in wooing Archana . But she rejects Arivazhagan and also another suitor Bhuvaneshwaran. Complications arise when she says she has been in love with Sundarapandiyan for a long time.

title: Budget Padmanabhan
overview: Padmanabhan has earned the nickname Budget as he is a miser. However, he struggles to save his father's house from money lenders as his wife is a spendthrift and never lets him save enough.

title: Vallavan
overview: A man loves a woman even though she is three years older than him. Although she reciprocates initially, the age difference and his past with a classmate lead her to break up with him.

title: Meesaya Murukku
overview: A passionate youngster who dreams of making it in the music industry is on the verge of losing his love. What will happen to his career and romance?

title: Vaa Vaathiyaar
overview: After being raised as the reincarnation of a famous actor, a man finds himself clashing with his grandfather's expectations of him.

title: Marudhamalai
overview: Marudhamalai, a cop, gets involved in a scuffle with the local gangster and helps the villagers get rid of his atrocities.

title: Raam
overview: Ram is falsely charged for killing his mother. His neigbours are also called for interrogation. Everyone's effort leads to tracking down the real killer.

title: Neranja Manasu
overview: The villagers of Suriyakudi believe that young Ayyanar will be their saviour. He soon gets Sivanandi imprisoned for killing his own father, and years later, Sivanandi returns to kill him.

title: Sirai
overview: As he transfers a young convict from prison to court, a police officer learns about the chain of events that led to the young man's conviction for violence.

title: Autograph
overview: Senthil, an advertising executive, decides to invite his old friends to his wedding. His past is unraveled as he sets out on a journey to meet his old friends and lovers.

title: Retta Thala
overview: Kaali, a struggling Pondicherry orphan encounters his rich Goa doppelganger Malpe Upendra with criminal past, leading to identity swaps and messy consequences. Corrupt cop Thiraviyam and Upendra’s enemies soon conspire to put that to an end.

title: Orange Mittai
overview: The journey of an old man and an EMT specialist in an ambulance becomes unexpectedly meaningful for both of them.

title: Chocobar
overview: Horror, Drama

title: Simba
overview: A stoner befriends a Great Dane, who is the pet of his neighbour, and tries to make her fall in love with him.

title: Anantha
overview: An anthology film centered on the divine grace and miracles of Sri Sathya Sai Baba, showcasing how faith transforms lives, featuring stories of a mischievous man's redemption and a village facing floods, emphasizing universal love and divinity, not a specific religion

title: Draupathi
overview: A man who is accused of killing his wife and her sister on the basis of casteism goes on a rampage to kill those who cheat upper-caste women in the pretense of having a romantic relationship.

title: Simple Manusan
overview: A 32-year-old barber enjoys his modest life but struggles with a deep sense of loneliness, believing that marriage could fill the void. Under pressure from his family, friends, and society, he embarks on a quest to find the perfect partner, exploring everything from dating apps to traditional matchmakers. Despite this, he faces a series of disappointments and rejections. As his search spirals into frustration, he begins to doubt if the life he seeks is even possible or if he's just chasing an illusion.

title: Mahasenha
overview: Mahasenha is a mythological jungle thriller set in the mystichills of Kurangani, where an ancient Yaali sculpture, worshipped by the tribal villagers as a divine protector, becomes the center of a high-stakes conflict. The film delivers a powerful message : Faith is not just belief-its protection.

title: Angammal
overview: In a remote, rustic mid-90s village in Tamil Nadu, An elderly widow fights to save her sense of individuality when her younger son demands that she wear a blouse to impress his prospective in-laws.

title: Virumaandi
overview: Angela, a civil advocate interviewing inmates at the Madras Central Prison for a documentary on the death penalty meets Virumaandi and Kothaala, who are sentenced to death and life respectively for their roles in perpetrating the massacre of 24 people during a brutal clash between feuding villages. As tensions mount within the prison walls, she listens to their conflicting accounts of the same story.

title: Mask
overview: 440 crores stolen. Seven days to get it back. A game of greed, betrayal and intrigue culminates in an explosive climax in this story of a greedy man, a conniving woman and an uncanny guy with a bag full of tricks.

title: Yellow
overview: A corporate worker's impulsive decision to leave her desk job leads to a transformative solo adventure, where strangers become friends and comfort zones fade into distant memories.

title: Kumki 2
overview: Bhumi sees an elephant in the jungle growing up without his others love. His teacher advises him to love nature and protect the birds and animals in the forest and live in harmony with them and he decided to protect the elephant. The broker offers the elephant as a sacrifice for the ministers post. Hearing this, Bhumi fights with them.

title: Iraivi
overview: Three men try to overcome the problems in their lives not realising the impact their efforts are having on the women in their lives.

title: Ghajini
overview: After being hit by an iron rod, Sanjay Ramaswamy, a business tycoon, suffers from anterograde amnesia. He is unable to remember anything beyond fifteen minutes. Under such circumstances, he sets out on a quest to find the people who were responsible for his lover Kalpana's murder.

title: Satyam
overview: A cop, doesn't believe in finishing criminals in fake encounters but in a judicial way. A powerful politician hires an assassin to get rid of his competitors.

title: Revolver Rita
overview: A woman must use her intelligence and grit to protect her family after they are unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of gang violence.

title: Michael Madana Kama Rajan
overview: A wicked man separates a set of quadruplets after their birth and one of them ends up with their biological father, while the other three find new homes. Things take a turn after they meet each other.

title: Maadan Kodai Vizha
overview: Determined to revive a long-forgotten tradition, Murugan embarks on a mission to organize the annual Sudalai Madan ceremony, which has been defunct for years. However, his efforts are met with fierce resistance from various quarters.  Adding to the challenge, Murugan's girlfriend lays down an ultimatum: she will only marry him if he succeeds in pulling off the ceremony. Against all odds, Murugan perseveres, rallying the village community to support his cause. Will he triumph in his quest, and how will he overcome the hurdles to successfully organize the ceremony?

title: Middle Class
overview: Karl Marx, a middle-class man in his mid-forties, lives in a small housing board quarters with his mouthy wife and his two kids. As long as he can remember Karl Marx had only one dream, to buy a couple of acres of land in his native village and do farming. This middle-class man with his middle-class dream gets a reversal of fortune because of a good deed done by his father in the past. That being a cheque for an amount of one crore rupees. But fate plays a cruel trick on Karl Marx as he misplaces the cheque and struggles to find it. He has only two days to find the missing cheque and encash it. Does he find it? Does he fulfil his dream? The story that unfolds is Middle Class

title: Marina
overview: Ambikapathy escapes to Chennai to fulfil his dreams and he earns a living by selling goods on a beach. He faces many hurdles along the way but manages to overcome them in his pursuit for happiness.

title: Little Hearts: Madness of Love
overview: A broke, desperate filmmaker fakes a public proposal to chase online fame. It goes viral, turning into real love, real fallout, and a harsh choice feed the algorithm or protect his heart in a world where emotions are content, at any cost

title: Dawood
overview: An unsuspecting cab driver takes up a petty job, only to fall into the deadly trap of a ruthless gangster. Now, he must fight for surviva or accept that he was born to be hunted

title: UnPaarvayil
overview: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.

title: Others
overview: A detective investigates alarming health issues in IVF babies, revealing a dark plot involving illegal steroids, mystery donors, and corrupt fertility clinics - all orchestrated by someone exploiting people's desire for children.

title: Aandavan Kattalai
overview: A young man, on the advice of an agent, lies that he is married, to go to London. But his visa application is rejected and now, he has to follow-up with a string of lies to hide one lie.

title: Kaantha
overview: Set in the backdrop of a film set, in the 1950’s in post colonial Madras, the film is centred around the professional rivalry between a film-maker trying to make his seminal film and the top reigning actor who the director once introduced. The rivalry spirals around the leading actress, a debutante and as the relationship between the three.

title: Theeyavar Kulaigal Nadunga
overview: An Investigative Police officer teams up with an autism school teacher to solve the mystery of a cruel murder happened in a school for autistic children.

title: Aaromaley
overview: Ajith, a romantic dreamer faces reality when forced to work at a matchmaking agency under Anjali,a pragmatic, grounded woman, devoid of dreamy illusions. Their conflicting ideologies become the foundation of a relationship that’s as charming as it is unfiltered.

title: Unnaal Ennaal
overview: Three youths come to Chennai in search of livelihood from the village due to poverty. The need for money chases them, and in a way comes an opportunity to run out of their need for money. But they see an injustice behind that opportunity  It seems to be the opportunity of the person who abuses them against conscience. At that moment were they compromised to overcome their poverty? Or did they decide that conscientious humanity is what matters?

title: Padayappa
overview: Padayappa, a mechanical engineer whose father gives up his property to his foster brother, and then dies of shock soon after. Neelambari initially loves Padayappa, but plans to humiliate him after his family humiliates her father. The rest of the plot deals with Padayappa overcoming all the obstacles placed by Neelambari.

title: Aasai
overview: A man kills his wife when she learns that he lusts after her sister. He then begins to make his moves for his sister-in-law. When he tries to sabotage the girl's marriage, her fiance gets suspicious.

title: Thuppakki
overview: Captain Jagadish, an intelligence officer in the Indian Army, returns to Mumbai for a vacation but soon finds himself in a deadly mission. After witnessing a bus bombing, he uncovers a network of sleeper cells planning multiple attacks across the city. With no official backing, he embarks on a personal mission with his trusted comrades to eliminate the mastermind, ensuring the sleeper cells remain leaderless and trapped in silence, waiting for orders that will never come. Ready to sacrifice his own life, he sets out on his final mission—but does he succeed, and at what cost?

title: Stephen
overview: A psychiatrist evaluating a self-confessed serial killer unravels a twisted web of trauma, deceit, and psychological manipulation—only to question if the killer is truly guilty or just another victim in a larger, darker game.

title: Gajaana
overview: A group of greedy people were entering enchanted Forest in search of treasure and unexpectedly they over come hurdles in a mysterious way. did they find the solution and did escape from the hurdles in the forest

title: Kattappava Kaanom
overview: A fish belonging to a gangster, who considers it his lucky charm, gets stolen and ends up with a guy whose luck has always been rotten.

title: Cristina Kathirvelan
overview: Kathirvelan is in love with Cristina . Both are give their documents to the witnesses for the registered marriage of the sister of the rowdy. In it, the hero and heroine who gave the documents to the witnesses receive a wrong marriage certificate as if they were married. The heroine Cristina is engaged to marry a stranger. Kathir fights and join.

title: Leelai
overview: Karthik’s flirting ways during his college days leave a bad impression on Malar. A few years later, the two end up working at the same office, though they are on different floors. Karthik falls in love with Malar but considering that she hates even the very mention of his name, he introduces himself to her as Sundar. How long can he carry on this game of deception?

title: Anjaan
overview: A man travels to Mumbai in search of his estranged brother, a feared figure in the criminal underworld. As he follows the trail through gang rivalries and shifting alliances, he uncovers a complex web of loyalty, deception, and violence that blurs the line between justice and revenge.

title: Murugesan +2
overview: Murugesan+2 is a darkly comic tale about Murugesan, a truck driver leading a secret double life with two families. When he is presumed dead after a severe accident, a promised settlement sparks a bitter feud between his wives and their families, each scheming for control of the money. Just as the battle turns vicious, Murugesan returns alive, only to become a burden to those who once mourned him. Faced with betrayal and greed, Murugesan and his disillusioned sons walk away, leaving behind a biting satire on family, loyalty, and the corrupting power of money.

title: Aaryan
overview: A struggling writer announces he'll commit the perfect crime, sparking a tense pursuit as police try to prevent his methodically planned killing spree.

title: Friends
overview: A man values his best friend more than anything else in the world. One day he confesses a dark secret from their childhood to his wife, which is overheard by another. Once the secret gets out, the friendship is destroyed.

title: Right
overview: A desperate father searching for his missing son finds himself trapped inside a police station when a mysterious entity seals the station building, forcing those within to confront their secrets as a deadly game.

title: Diesel
overview: During the 1980s, Manoharan was a leader in the city's crude oil smuggling business. Manohar opposed Patanis dream of setting up a private port that would become a hub for the black market oil trade. He looted a large quantity of oil from the pipeline to blackmail the government into fulfilling his dream. Finally, the Vasu finds the missing oil.

title: Dude
overview: Childhood friends Agan and Kural are inseparable. When Kural encounters romantic troubles, Agan must balance his hidden feelings for her with his desire to ensure her happiness.

title: Kumki
overview: The story revolves around a mahout and his trained elephant.

title: Aan Paavam Pollathathu
overview: A year into their marriage, unable to distinguish between toxicity and mere misunderstandings, Sakthi decides to part ways with Siva. The couple navigate their separation, and whether they ultimately proceed with divorce forms the emotional climax.

title: Magamuni
overview: Two long-separated brothers end up in life-threatening situations. How do their lives intersect and what happens next?

title: India Pakistan
overview: It is only after moving in to their shared office space do Karthick and Mellina realize that they are in the same profession — law. So, they decide that whoever gets a case first will stay in the place and fight tooth-and-nail to get a case. Meanwhile, a cop, who is searching for a DVD containing video of his illegal encounter, is after Mellina thinking that she is in possession of it.

title: Kiss
overview: A musician is gifted with the supernatural ability to see a couple's destiny whenever they kiss. But when he sees the grim fate of the woman he loves, he must use his powers to defy destiny itself.

title: Kuttram Pudhithu
overview: When Kadhiresan, a disturbed soul masked as a food delivery man, kills and gets arrested for the horrific murder of ACP Sathya’s daughter Preethi, reality fractures and tensions intensify—until Preethi returns back from the dead unharmed five days later, challenging not just law and logic, but the very nature of truth and existence.

title: Marutham
overview: Kanniyappan, A Hardworking Farmer, Is Devastated When He Learns That His Ancestral Farmland Has Been Auctioned Off Due To An Unpaid Loan. Despite Being A Diligent Farmer, Kanniyappan Is Shocked Because He Never Took Out Any Loan From A Bank Or Any Financial Institution. His Peaceful Life Takes A Dark Turn As He Begins To Unravel The Truth Behind This Mysterious Auction.

title: Bad Girl
overview: From her journey through high school and college, then out into the wider world, Ramya’s dream of finding the perfect guy is obstructed by societal mores, strict parents, unrequited love and the untrammeled chaos of her own mind.

title: Igloo
overview: Webbed around a couple who believe, preach and practise positivity, where the ‘picture perfect’ lives of a couple are devastated with a hazardous illness and how they handle it positively

title: Thandakaaranyam
overview: After losing his forest ranger position, a Tamil villager pursues his dream of joining the Indian Army, only to face harsh realities that challenge his idealistic vision of military service.

title: Sotta Sotta Nanaiyuthu
overview: Sotta Sotta Ninayuthu is a romantic drama about Raja, a wealthy young man whose baldness fuels deep insecurity and heartbreak. Though he finds love with the kind-hearted Priya, a moment of doubt drives him away, and his family soon pushes him toward Shruti—a modern, arrogant woman who clashes with their values. Caught between duty and desire, Raja must choose whether to follow his heart or surrender to expectations.

title: Mr. Zoo Keeper
overview: A zookeeper dedicated to taking care of wild animals finds himself in a difficult situation with law enforcement officials.

title: Blackmail
overview: Trapped in escalating blackmail, Mani faces mounting danger as crime, passion, and greed intertwine, exposing hidden truths and changing allegiances throughout his ordeal.

title: Maria
overview: The story explores about the liberation and freedom of a Nun, where she wants to live like a normal woman but society and the family around her makes it difficult, finally what happens to her at the end.

title: Idli Kadai
overview: A simple man's search for success leads him to rediscover his roots.

title: Shakthi Thirumagan
overview: A tribal woman is brutally assaulted and killed. Her newborn is mercilessly abandoned in a dump yard, left to die. But fate intervenes — an old man discovers the infant and decides to raise him as his own. The child, named Kittu,After the old man’s death, Kittu is left to fend for himself,determined to confront his mother’s killer.

title: Kuyili
overview: The Story Unfolds Through an Intricate, Multi-character Narrative With Alternating Perspectives. Kuyili, a Woman From a Small, Oppressed Village, Initially Lives an Ordinary Life. After the Tragic Death of Her Husband Due to Alcoholism, She is Left to Raise Her Child Alone. Through Her Brother, She Learns That Many Women in Their Community Have Suffered Similar Losses. Determined to Bring Change, Kuyili Joins the Communist Party, a Political Movement Dedicated to Achieving Socio-economic Justice and Eliminating Systemic Exploitation.

title: Parasakthi
overview: Set against the backdrop of World War II, three brothers are separated by war while their sister Kalyani faces immense struggles after being widowed and left destitute. As each sibling endures hardship and societal injustice, their paths cross in unexpected ways, culminating in a dramatic courtroom trial that exposes the harsh realities of their world and sets the stage for a powerful family reunion.

title: Vikram
overview: Amar is assigned to investigate a case of serial killings. When Amar investigates the case, he realizes it is not what it seems to be and following down this path will lead to nothing but war between everyone involved.

title: Remo
overview: An aspiring actor dresses up as a female nurse to bag a role in a film, and more importantly, woo the love of his life.

title: Maya Puthagam
overview: An aspiring filmmaker, Guru, plagued by recurring dreams of a magical book and a serpent, ventures into a mysterious forest palace. What unfolds is a tale of ancient curses, invisible protectors, and cinematic ambitions colliding with supernatural forces.

title: Thanal
overview: Fuelled by a lifetime of suffering, an ex army man embarks on a vengeful quest. Standing in his way is a police constable whose own past pain transformed into a dutiful son. When their paths converge, hero either can flee for his life or take a stand against the villain’s scheme of things.

title: Dear Jeeva: An Unconditional Love Story
overview: Jeeva,a next-door guy who is seeking a job and living alone and Ms Jeeva is a focused workaholic. When they met for an interview, they began to like each other and fell in love.After a lot of emotional journey, both got married and started their lives happily. However, after a few months of marriage, Jeeva lost his job. Mrs. Jeeva received an onsite opportunity simultaneously.Ego starts to build between them and at one point Mrs. Jeeva wants to distance herself from him, but The news of Covid-lockdown has left them with no choice but to stay together.The rest of the story is about how situations during the lockdown helped them understand each other, whether they separated or accepted each other.

title: Iru Mugan
overview: A disgraced  RAW agent Akilan (Vikram) is recalled by the agency to track down a crazy scientist and a cross dresser Love (also Vikram), who has discovered a deadly new drug  ‘Speed inhaler’.

title: En Kadhale
overview: Helen, a young English woman from London, falls in love with Deena, a fisherman boy from a coastal village in Tamil Nadu. Their love faces many struggles as some people try to separate them.The story follows their emotional journey and the challenges they face for their love. Will their love succeed?

title: Suttaa Thale Enakku
overview: A powerful tycoon partners with Margaya Island`s kingpin to smuggle a highly valuable package across international borders. Chaos ensues when so called local gangsters and a group of tourists join forces to stop them.

title: Uruttu Uruttu
overview: A village girl's heart unexpectedly belongs to a gang member who allegedly wronged her. As she defies her gangster father to protect him, their forbidden love unleashes chaos in their dangerous world.

title: Rambo
overview: Gowtham a ruthless heir to an education empire and Ram, a kind hearted orphanage caretaker, are raised with opposing beliefs. When Malar exposes Gowtham's dark secret, the two men face off in a brutal test of power and fists.

title: Madras Matinee
overview: An aging sci-fi writer is challenged by his caretaker to write about the life of a common man. Reluctantly, he begins the story of Kannan, an auto rickshaw driver, and his family—only to discover that ordinary life holds unexpected depth and drama.

title: Bomb
overview: Bomb is a comedy film set in the fictional village of Kaalakammaipatty, where a man named Kathiravan dies unexpectedly but even after death, he won’t stop farting. His body becomes the center of chaos, confusion, and laughter as the villagers try to figure out the Reason.

title: Naalai Namadhe
overview: Naalai Namadhe, a village ruled by the wealthy where no elections have been held for years, a young woman dares to contest, challenging power and awakening change. Inspired by Lenin`s words, the film is a bold take on reclaiming political voice and justice.

title: Gandhi Kannadi
overview: An ambitious young event planner named Kathir sees a big opportunity when an elderly man, Gandhi, hires him to plan his 60th wedding anniversary. As their dreams and desires intertwine, their journey becomes a moving tale of love, conflict, and hope.

title: Phoenix
overview: A teenage boxer accused of a high-profile political murder is quietly sent to a juvenile reformatory, where relentless assassination attempts test his survival. As he battles for his life and identity behind bars, he must summon inner strength to confront a dangerous past and hostile enemies.

title: Aadhavan
overview: A professional assassin is tasked with the murder of a prominent local judge; however, after a series of failed attempts, he is forced to deal with complications and old relationships arising from his troubled past.

title: Kushi
overview: College friends Jenny and Shiva part ways due to a misunderstanding. Although they are in love and realize they cannot live without each other, their egos prevent them from uniting.

title: Madharaasi
overview: A man with a psychological disorder overcomes trauma and confronts his nemesis in a fast-paced action film with romance and unique elements, exploring themes of resilience and redemption.

title: Bangalore Naatkal
overview: Three cousins, Arjun, Divya and Kannan, relocate to Bangalore for various reasons. However, they face many challenges which change their lives forever.

title: House Mates
overview: Karthick and Anu fall in love, get married and buy an old flat for their own. Many strange incidents happening in that house. They found out the reason and hand over the flat to the first owner Ramesh.

title: The Savage
overview: Desires play a key role in misplaced lives of two men and two women and the violent consequences following it makes them emotionally unstable-leading them to betrayal, revenge and collision of fates that binds their lives forever

title: Vembu
overview: Vembu follows the journey of a bold village girl passionate about martial arts. Raised by her supportive father, she dreams of excelling in martial arts while preparing for government exams. Pressured by society, she agrees to marry her cousin Vetri. Understanding her inner conflict, Vetri promises to support her dreams. As financial struggles arise, Vembu steps up to take care of the family. The film portrays her resilience and determination to rise above challenges and pursue her passion.

title: Jenma Natchathiram
overview: A team's treasure hunt leads them to a deserted bungalow, where they soon find themselves in a terrifying battle against paranormal dangers.

title: Coolie
overview: Deva, once living a quiet life, is shaken when his close friend dies under suspicious circumstances. Determined to uncover the truth, he infiltrates a powerful gang operating in the shadows. As he investigates, Deva becomes entangled in a dangerous web of crime, betrayal, and secrets from his own past, forcing him to confront powerful enemies while protecting the ones he loves.

title: Winner
overview: A young man moves to his hometown; here he falls in love with the village head's daughter. The village head learns about this and he has the girl abducted; if the young man tries to rescue her, his parent's life will be at stake.

title: Enai Sudum Pani
overview: Women are going missing in Pollachi and police have shirked their responsibility to catch the criminal. Vetri and Aparna are neighbours and have been in love since childhood. She is a responsible adult, with her own business, and he is a fun loving young man, with the ambition to become an IPS officer. A dead body is discovered and the parents of the dead woman.

title: Indra
overview: INDRA is a serial killer investigation film about an ex-cop who lost his eyesight and sets out to find the killer terrorizing the town. What follows is a gripping chase full of twists and turns — but what if the hunter ends up becoming the hunted?

title: Bun Butter Jam
overview: Two mothers, disillusioned by failed marriages, team up to orchestrate a master plan to unite their freshman kids, Chandru and Madhu. But things get muddied when their Gen Z kids have other plans, leading to a clash of wills and generational divide.

title: Aruvam
overview: A food safety officer and a teacher who has no sense of smell come together to fight the practice of food adulteration and its devastating effect on people.

title: Kanthaswamy
overview: A CBI officer moonlights as a modern day Robin Hood in the guise of the masked Kanthaswamy, as he helps fight corruption and aid impoverished people.

title: Tamil School Pasanga
overview: TAMIL SCHOOL PASANGA follows the journey of Kesavan, a passionate and dedicated schoolteacher who is transferred to a struggling Tamil school in need of transformation. With unwavering commitment, Kesavan embraces his students as his own, guiding them with patience and understanding, while inspiring their parents to adopt teaching methods tailored to their children’s unique needs. He also works closely with the school’s teachers, helping them recognize that every child learns differently and that a little extra effort, combined with creativity, can unlock their true potential. This heartwarming story celebrates the power of compassion, resilience, and the impact of education in shaping young lives.

title: Maayakoothu
overview: A writer's tale unravels-a magical and mystical ride through realms unknown.

title: Raja
overview: Conflict arises between two brothers after the death of their father and unknowingly they become rivals.

title: Aviyal
overview: Aviyal is a collection of four short films : A young man attracted to his aunt, a filmmaker chasing robbers who have stolen his short film, two friends going on a trip to deposit the ashes of their friend and a gangster narrating a story.

title: Surrender
overview: The story unfolds Five days prior during election season, where a police team and a notorious gangster are significantly affected by the election. Ultimately, the narrative leads to a decisive resolution of their conflict with many twists, turns, and emotions.

title: Peranbum Perungobamum
overview: The story follows the protagonist's three phases of life, and the antagonists, the caste heads of the village whom he avenges for the wounds and sufferings he and his beloved endured in the past.

title: Maareesan
overview: A petty thief embarks on a road trip with an elderly man suffering from memory loss under deceptive pretenses. As they journey across Tamil Nadu, the promise of an easy con unravels into a quietly shifting connection, with both men hiding secrets of their own.

title: Mirugasirisham: The Orion
overview: A family is haunted by strange and frightening events, forcing them to seek the help of a tok guru to resolve their dispute. Can the tok guru uncover the cause of the disturbance before things get more serious? Or is there something bigger waiting?

title: Thani Oruvan
overview: An idealistic cop and an ambitious scientist-businessman indulge in a high-stake battle of wits.

title: Gevi
overview: Gevi is a Tamil Survival Thriller Film That Follows Mandharai and Malaiyan's Struggle for Justice in a Rural Village Near Kodaikanal. The Film Explores Themes of Love, Survival, and Bureaucratic Apathy, Highlighting the Community's Fight Against Corruption and Adversity. A Powerful Story of Hope and Resilience

title: Good Day
overview: Shanthakumar, a textile employee,  humiliated and beaten on his birthday, driven by rage and a need for justice,  decides to throw himself a very different kind of birthday party. Intoxicated and aimless, He embarks on a darkly comic walk through the night towards redemption.

title: Thalaivan Thalaivii
overview: Two headstrong lovers navigate a turbulent relationship where passion and conflict intertwine, creating an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.

title: Love Marriage
overview: Ram, a 33-year-old Bachelor From Madurai, Faces Mounting Pressure to Get Married. Amidst Cultural Expectations and Comic Misadventures, He Embarks on a Journey of Self-discovery, Questioning Tradition and Seeking His Own Path to Happiness

title: School
overview: In Winner Higher Secondary School, a series of mysterious deaths leads to the revelation that two spirits former students who died tragically have returned to prevent further loss caused by a toxic mindset of success. As a sorcerer named Mastaan tries to exploit the chaos, two spirit-sent teachers transform the school by challenging narrow definitions of achievement and promoting equality, mental well-being, and humanity. The film concludes with a powerful message: true success lies not in degrees or prestige, but in empathy, self-discovery, and purpose.

title: Trending
overview: A vlogging couple chasing online popularity, desperately go to great lengths and does things to remain in the limelight as the “trending” pair, and their relationship begins to deteriorate.

title: Oho Enthan Baby
